name: web-tools
description: The portable set from mehrlander/web-tools as installable plugins: the working-conventions loader, the surfacing caption, the skill-library loader, the show-repo instrument, and the daisy-alpine reference.

plugins.name: portable
plugins.description: The to-go bag: /portable:web-tools (load the portable working conventions), /portable:caption (the surfacing caption), /portable:load-skill (fetch any skill from the library), /portable:show-repo (browse and move files across repos), /portable:tasks (operate the cross-session project tracker), /portable:repo-review (read the repo's state and report what stands out, at three depths), /portable:tree (render a linked file tree for chat), /portable:in-flight (check whether any branch, PR, or task is already working on something), /portable:markers (what is frozen, stale, or wrong, and what must not be edited), and /portable:sandbox-traps (name a web-sandbox failure that impersonates a worse one). Also carries two hooks that run on their own: the session recorder (Stop), inert unless a checkout declares a sessions store, and the session dispatcher (SessionStart), which runs every checkout's own .claude/hooks/session-*.sh whatever the project root is. Vendors the two conventions docs and an injector a repo can opt into through the dispatcher, so loading them costs no fetch.

plugins.name: daisy-alpine
plugins.description: DaisyUI 5 + Tailwind 4 + Alpine.js reference for single-file HTML artifacts. Model-invocable, so it triggers on matching artifact work without being asked.
